turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Why did my son find out from his phone?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM, noted. A file's creation time says nothing about when he wrote it. You still haven't answered me: who decided to enter that zero before anyone called me?
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
Spare me. Who entered the zero, and why before a phone call?
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
Hale, I didn't come for compliments. Third time: who decided on that zero before calling me?
